    {

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, on or about an individual's person or accessible property when: (1) performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) entering or in a sterile area; or (3) attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: One or more of the following circumstances: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft under this subchapter; (2) when entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property under paragraph (a) of this section.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Paragraph (a) prohibitions do not apply if the individual is one of the following: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a weapon while performing duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon under §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless all specified conditions in (i) through (iv) are met.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Transportation is prohibited unless all four conditions are satisfied: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, orally or in writing, before checking baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in the bag and it is unloaded; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container is locked and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator (orally or in writing before checking baggage) that the bag contains an unloaded firearm, the firearm is unloaded, the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unauthorized explosive or incendiary in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under 49 CFR 1540.111, regarding carriage in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Either carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: This section does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
unit_attributes.statement: Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing the carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
